title: Addressing the Onboarding agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Onboarding agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `onboarding-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Orienting and ordered
rules.description: Orienting and ordered. Which repo this is, what to run first, where the governing skill lives. Say what NOT to do as explicitly as what to do.

source.quote: Meets a repository it has never seen and must orient before acting. Will follow the first plausible convention it finds, so the earliest instruction it reads matters most.
